title: Echo Questions 回聲問句

source.file: Sentence Structure 228 - Echo Questions 回聲問句.pdf

The source filename is numbered 228; it is assigned system ID ss229 because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formulas.formula: Subject + verb + who / what / where / when / how much / how many + ?

meaning.zh: 回聲問句把剛聽到的全部內容或其中一部分問回對方，用來表達驚訝、難以置信、興趣、確認或沒有聽清楚。

rules.zh: 保留陳述句語序 正確的回聲問句： Your brother cooked this meal? 不符合本課目標： Did your brother cook this meal? 第二句是一般問句，而不是重複剛聽到內容的完整回聲問句。
rules.en: Keep statement word order in an echo question. “Your brother cooked this meal?” is the target; “Did your brother cook this meal?” is an ordinary information question.

rules.zh: 保留原有時態及助動詞 She is leaving? They were waiting outside? He can drive? The meeting has been cancelled? 不要因為句子變成問句而自行加入 do、does 或 did。
rules.en: Keep the original tense and auxiliary. Do not add do, does or did merely because the sentence now ends with a question mark.

rules.zh: 對話人物改變時，代名詞也要改變 Speaker A: I lost my keys. Speaker B: You lost your keys? 說話者A的 I，在說話者B的回應中會變成 you。 其他常見轉換包括： ● my → your ● your → my ● me → you ● we → you / we，視乎對話情況而定
rules.en: Change pronouns when the speaker changes: a speaker’s I normally becomes you in the listener’s echo response, with corresponding my/your and me/you changes.

rules.zh: 回聲問句通常不倒裝 Echo question: She bought what? Ordinary question: What did she buy? Echo question: The class starts when? Ordinary question: When does the class start?
rules.en: Wh-echo questions normally keep the wh-word in the position of the surprising or unheard information: “She bought what?” rather than “What did she buy?”

rules.zh: 書面上要使用問號 在說話中，回聲問句通常配合上升語調。 在書面對話中，必須在句末使用問號。
rules.en: Use a question mark in writing. In speech, echo questions normally use rising intonation.

rules.zh: 回聲問句主要用於對話 它常見於： ● 日常對話； ● 電話交談； ● 電影及故事對白； ● 訪問； ● 口語討論。 正式報告及學術文章通常不會大量使用這種句式。
rules.en: Echo questions are mainly conversational and common in calls, dialogue, interviews and spoken discussion; they are not normally frequent in formal reports or academic writing.

benefits.zh: 它能立即表達驚訝 當你聽到意料之外的消息時，不需要先組織一個很長的回應，只需把關鍵內容問回對方。 A: Sam won the competition. B: Sam won the competition? 這樣便能立即表示你對消息感到驚訝。
benefits.en: It expresses surprise immediately by repeating the unexpected message without constructing a long response.

benefits.zh: 它能幫助你確認資料 有時你已經大致聽到對方的話，但想確認自己沒有聽錯。 A: The train leaves at five. B: The train leaves at five? 這個回應自然地表示：「我聽到的是五點，對嗎？」
benefits.en: It helps confirm information when you think you heard correctly but want the speaker to verify it.

benefits.zh: 它能指出你沒有聽清楚的部分 你不需要要求對方重複整句，只需問回缺少的資料。 A: I paid three hundred dollars. B: You paid how much? 對方會立即知道你需要他重複價錢。
benefits.en: It identifies the exact detail you did not hear by replacing only that information with a wh-word.

benefits.zh: 它能令口語反應更快、更自然 在真實對話中，人們未必有時間設計完整而正式的問句。 回聲問句提供一個簡單的反應框架： Statement word order + ? 你可以保留大部分剛聽到的句子，只改變語調和標點。
benefits.en: It makes spoken reactions faster and more natural by retaining most of the statement and changing only intonation and punctuation.

benefits.zh: 它能鼓勵對方繼續解釋 當你問： You left your job? 對方通常會自然地補充原因或背景。這有助維持對話，而不是只回答 yes 或 no。
benefits.en: It encourages the other speaker to continue explaining and often invites reasons or background.

benefits.zh: 它讓你選擇回應多少內容 你可以重複： ● 整個消息：You are moving to Canada? ● 一項資料：You are moving where? ● 一個短語：To Canada? 因此，你可以把注意力準確地放在最令你意外或最需要確認的部分。
benefits.en: It lets you repeat a full message, one detail or a short phrase, so you can focus precisely on what surprised you or needs confirmation.

en: Complete Speaker B’s response as an echo question using statement word order.
Change pronouns where the speaker changes and end every answer with a question mark.
zh: 完成說話者 B 的回應，把它寫成保留陳述句語序的回聲問句。
按說話者轉換代名詞，並在每個答案句末使用問號。
